business_summary: Essex Bio-Technology Limited, an investment holding company, develops, manufactures, and sells biologic drugs in China, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through Ophthalmology, Surgical, and Healthcare and Partner Services segments. The company researches and develops therapeutic fibroblast growth factor products to treat cellular proliferation, differentiation, and migration. It offers Beifushu series, such as Beifushu eye drops, eye gel, and unit-dose eye drops to treat ocular wounds; and Tobramycin, Levofloxacin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Diquafosol Sodium, and Moxifloxacin Hydrochloride eye drops, as well as Iodized lecithin capsules. The company also provides healthtech e-platform-related medical services, Beifuji spray and lyophilized powder, and Beifuxin gels to treat surface wounds. It offers Carisolv, a dental caries removal gel; mouthwash; oral care products; portable ultraviolet phototherapy devices; PELNACTM, a collagen-based artificial dermis; SCALGENTM, a double-layered artificial dermis; bioresorbable implants for dental surgery; hydrophilic contact lens; and other medical devices for myopia control and prevention; eye-protection lamp; and defocus customized glasses. The company develops SkQ1 eye drop, which is in the second phase 3 clinical trial; Bevacizumab ophthalmic injection for wet-AMD, which is in phase 3 clinical trial; and EB11-21148P, which is in phase 2 clinical trial, as well as new therapeutics in oncology, orthopedics, and neurology. It has license agreements with Mitotech S.A. for a clinical trial of an ophthalmic solution containing SkQ1 for dry eye disease; and Shanghai Henlius Biotech Inc. to co-develop a pharmaceutical product that contains an anti-vascular endothelial growth factor as a drug substance, which is intended to treat macular degeneration. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Zhuhai, China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Essex Bio-Technology Limited는 중국, 홍콩 및 국제적으로 생물학적 의약품을 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 안과, 외과, 의료 및 파트너 서비스 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 세포 증식, 분화 및 이동을 치료하기 위한 치료용 섬유아세포 성장 인자 제품을 연구 및 개발합니다. Beifushu 안약, 안약, 안구 상처 치료용 단위 용량 안약 등 Beifushu 시리즈를 제공합니다. 토브라마이신, 레보플록사신, 히알루론산 나트륨, 디쿠아포솔 나트륨, 목시플록사신 염산염 점안약, 요오드화 레시틴 캡슐 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 헬스테크 e-플랫폼 관련 의료 서비스, 베이후지 스프레이 및 동결건조 분말, 표면 상처 치료용 베이푸신 젤 등을 제공하고 있습니다. 치아 우식 제거 젤인 Carisolv를 제공합니다. 구강 청결제; 구강 관리 제품; 휴대용 자외선 광선치료 장치; 콜라겐 기반 인공 진피인 PELNACTM; 이중층 인공 진피인 SCALGENTM; 치과 수술용 생체흡수성 임플란트; 친수성 콘택트렌즈; 근시 관리 및 예방을 위한 기타 의료 기기; 눈 보호 램프; 및 디포커스 맞춤형 유리
